stories.title: G7 declaration links Ukraine's sovereignty, Iran nuclear inspections and Hormuz shipping

They reaffirmed support for Ukraine and European inclusion in future European security talks, urged a reciprocal ceasefire and demanded safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz.
